details.description: Leanstral 1.5 is Mistral AI's open-weight model for formal verification and automated theorem proving in the Lean 4 proof assistant, released June 30, 2026 as the successor to the original Leanstral (v26.03), which Mistral has marked deprecated as of 5/22/2026 and is retiring 6/30/2026. It is a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 119 billion total parameters and 6 billion active parameters, licensed Apache 2.0, and is also offered as a free API endpoint. Mistral trained it through mid-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with CISPO so it can act as an agentic proof-engineering assistant that edits files and runs bash commands using Lean language servers for feedback. On Mistral's own documentation (checked 2026-09-24) it carries a 'Public Preview' label rather than general availability.
advantages: Saturates the miniF2F benchmark and solves 587 of 672 problems on PutnamBench, per Mistral's launch post.
Achieves a new state-of-the-art among tested models of 87% on FATE-H and 34% on FATE-X, per Mistral's launch post.
Lifts pass@1 on Mistral's open-sourced FLTEval benchmark from 21.9 to 28.9, and pass@8 from 31.9 to 43.2, versus the original Leanstral, per Mistral's launch post.

Operates autonomously in a raw filesystem, editing files and running bash commands with Lean language server feedback; Mistral reports it uncovered 5 previously unreported bugs across 57 tested repositories.
Openly licensed under Apache 2.0 with weights on Hugging Face, plus a free API endpoint, per Mistral's docs and launch post.
Supports function calling, structured outputs, and the Agents & Conversations API, per Mistral's model documentation.
disadvantages: Labeled 'Public Preview' rather than generally available on Mistral's model documentation (checked 2026-09-24).
Narrowly specialized for Lean 4 formal verification and theorem proving rather than general-purpose chat or coding assistance.
Text-only, with no image input, per Bud's catalog facts.
use_cases: Automated theorem proving and formal proof generation in Lean 4
Autoformalization of mathematical statements into Lean 4
Agentic verification of code properties against formal specifications
Bug discovery in existing codebases via formal proof techniques

notes: The docs page's click-to-copy API id is exactly 'labs-leanstral-1-5', matching this target's uri. Catalog facts (262144 max input / 131072 max output tokens) match the docs page's stated 256k context window. Parameter count differs slightly between Mistral's own pages: the launch post states '119B total and only 6B active parameters', while the docs page's meta description rounds active parameters to 6.5B; used the blog's 6B figure, which matches the model's Hugging Face repo naming ('119B-A6B'). PutnamBench's 587/672 (87.4%) figure was reached at a 4M-token-per-attempt budget; Mistral's own chart shows far fewer problems solved at smaller budgets (e.g. 44 at a 50k-token budget), so this score reflects a generous compute budget, not a fixed default. The deprecation table on the models-overview page confirms the original Leanstral (labs-leanstral-2603) is deprecated 5/22/2026 and retires 6/30/2026, replaced by this model.
